# A17-S32: Development plan

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

Tak [████] :-)

Also, greetings from [████]! He and I had a great debate, and 
I clearly convinced him of the project's validity.

Here is an update on everything, which also has some questions - none urgent as 
.

Maybe we should start preparing that TV debate where [████] maybe 
could be moderator? Thinking it could be an obvious application to 
 Municipality, and we can probably get libraries involved again. You said at 
 one point that you had some ideas on who we could invite?

have several things going on in the funding area:
- a seed funding with workshops for 100.000
- a subproject in a research application to Ny Carlsberg where there are also 
funds allocated for workshops with companies
- Larger application to Novo Nordisk with us + Kunsthal Aarhus
- initial talks with KPMG about collaboration+funding
- initial talks with [████] and the ADD project [████] about collaboration+funding

- Had [████] looked at anything?

I've also reached out to CATCH. [████]

Currently discussing some ideas with [████] and Together regarding production of more 
 artworks.

The event calendar continues with plenty of action the next month: will 
 perform and/or teach about DSP on 30 September, 10 October, 15 October, 
24 October, 28 October, and maybe also 31. If there is also an election, 
 it will really escalate.

Lastly: election posters. Is there anything I can do as it stands?

All good, [████] 🙃
